title.zh: ⚡️Starknet考虑转为L1以自主推进量子安全升级，最快2027年实现相关升级
title.en: ⚡️Starknet考虑转为L1以自主推进量子安全升级，最快2027年实现相关升级

current_state.zh: Starknet正在就研究转为独立后量子L1进行七天非约束性STRK持有人投票，投票于10月22日结束，结果尚未公布；该投票不授权实际迁移，后续仍需进一步治理提案和投票。
current_state.en: Starknet is holding a seven-day non-binding STRK holder vote on researching an independent post-quantum L1, closing Oct. 22 with results not yet published; the vote does not authorize an actual transition and further governance proposals would be required.

updates.title_en: ⚡️Starknet考虑转为L1以自主推进量子安全升级，最快2027年实现相关升级
updates.what_changed_zh: StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson表示，Starknet正在权衡包括转为L1在内的多种选项，以便能够独立推动其后量子安全迁移，升级最早可能在2027年到来。
updates.what_changed_en: StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson said Starknet is weighing options including converting to an L1 so it can independently drive its post-quantum security migration, with upgrades potentially arriving as early as 2027.

updates.title_zh: Starknet就因量子风险可能退出以太坊L2开启投票
updates.title_en: Starknet opens vote on potential Ethereum L2 exit over quantum risks
updates.what_changed_zh: Starknet已开启为期七天的STRK持有人非约束性投票，询问是否研究成为独立的后量子Layer-1以摆脱对以太坊量子安全升级时间表的依赖；投票于10月22日结束，结果公布；Yes仅支持进一步研究，不授权迁移，也无L1时间表。
updates.what_changed_en: Starknet opened a seven-day non-binding STRK holder vote on whether to research becoming an independent post-quantum layer-1 to reduce dependence on Ethereum's quantum-security upgrade timeline; voting closes Oct. 22, results will be published, and a Yes vote only supports further research without authorizing a transition or setting an L1 timetable.
updates.current_state_zh: Starknet正在就研究转为独立后量子L1进行七天非约束性STRK持有人投票，投票于10月22日结束，结果尚未公布；该投票不授权实际迁移，后续仍需进一步治理提案和投票。
updates.current_state_en: Starknet is holding a seven-day non-binding STRK holder vote on researching an independent post-quantum L1, closing Oct. 22 with results not yet published; the vote does not authorize an actual transition and further governance proposals would be required.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Starknet has opened a seven-day, non-binding STRK holder vote on whether to research becoming an independent post-quantum layer-1 chain to avoid dependence on Ethereum's quantum-security upgrade schedule.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Starknet has opened a seven-day, non-binding STRK holder vote on whether to research becoming an independent post-quantum layer-1 chain to avoid dependence on Ethereum's quantum-security upgrade schedule.
